pages.text: $(o)A wrecked ship rides the deep ocean, and something holds it in its arms. Its crew still fights for it.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() Its tentacles rise around the deck one after another. Cut them down as they come up, and keep the cannons off you.$(br2)Fight on the ship, not in the water.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Abyssal Ink$() counts for the quest book. Its teeth make the Kraken Trident.
